name: Ops desk agent
description: Answers questions from the Olist operations desk with read-only SQL over the marketplace data, and cites the rows behind every number. It serves this card only and does not take A2A calls yet.

skills.name: Answer marketplace questions
skills.description: Answers a question about orders, sellers, products and reviews with the rows that prove it.
examples: How many sellers are based in Sao Paulo city?
What share of delivered orders arrived late?

skills.name: Quote customer reviews
skills.description: Finds the Portuguese reviews behind a number and quotes them with an English gloss.
examples: What do the one-star reviews of the late Sao Paulo sellers say?
